meaning: Source implementation review accepted; no model admission, quality result, or goal-completion claim.

authorship_disclosure.training.py: Written by this reviewer; self-reviewed implementation and AST/compile only. worker/deployment/controller/verify are read-only cross-source reviews.

scope.local_validation: AST parse and compile without execution for five sources; no torch import, operator execution, real QA, scoring, model, CUDA, or server access by this review.
scope.not_reviewed_as_results: The separately authorized single GPU operator check and all real phases have not been executed or consumed by this reviewer.

checks.same_damaged_function_and_fixed_recovery: Both arms strictly reload the same fixed eight-FFN-deleted graph and train original native SeqLinear on the same 144 remaining modules / 288 FP32 A/B Parameters / 3293184 coordinates.
checks.shared_memory_and_student_budget: 160 FIT QA selected by predetermined per-domain bottom32 rule; same domain round-robin twice, 320 per-QA backwards / 20 positive-LR AdamW updates. No DEV/TEST optimization or response-based data selection.
checks.teacher_positions_and_targets: Teacher no_grad/eval caches only cloned post-final-norm hidden at prompt_length-1:-1, predicting the same gold tokens truncated to512 plus EOS. Head values are bound equal to the frozen student head. Prefix160 and head320 calls are separately charged.
checks.loss: CE mean over each answer including EOS; KL teacher||student sums vocabulary then means answer tokens. KD=(CE+KL)/2 at T1; per-QA losses accumulated equally /16. Native SeqLinear FP32 storage under outer FP16 autocast is accurately disclosed.
checks.paired_initialization_and_RNG: Fresh same-pruned reload and native constructor; paired seed reset after teacher/cache construction; verifier compares actual initial adapter/frozen/buffer digests. Student optimizer shape/order/recipe shared; teacher computation is additional.
checks.GPU_contract: Actual explicit CUDA devices, no single-card masking assumption; model construction/forward/backward/AdamW/fold use GPU. CPU copies are hashing/serialization/input metadata. Fold GPU FP32 with autocast/TF32 disabled, output FP16; no claim of historical CPU-fold bitwise equivalence.
checks.physical_deployment: Physically absent fixed eight FFNs; no A/B, teacher, optimizer, or cache in new static package. Tied embedding/head aliases, complete789080096 coefficients, strict static reload, complete digest and nonpersistent-buffer invariants are checked.
checks.evaluation_and_cost: Independent final evaluation processes generate100 original DEV then five fixed32-token matching windows as the old reference. Whole-training phase peaks and matched inference-window peaks are separately recorded. Both arms finish before one200-answer score; historical anchors copied only under bound prior proofs.
checks.fixed_exit: Four cases run without outcome-dependent retry/branch. CE preferred if its full parent floors/resources pass; KD requires all floors/resources plus macro above CE. Merely recovering above damaged19.62 is insufficient.

scientific_limits: This explicitly adds post-stream recovery to the same damaged function under a disclosed narrow revision; a new process does not make it non-recovery.

The comparison identifies this fixed teacher-soft-target objective package under the specified extra memory/20 updates, not a unique explanation of deletion interactions or general necessity of distillation.

Historical parent training, deletion selection, teacher/cache/head calls, recovery, physical export/reload and evaluation costs remain separately accountable. Equal student updates do not imply equal total computation.
Maximum structural weight saving is11.704% and historical matched inference saving about193-200MiB; even a passing component would not establish the complete online CL framework or paper target.
